title: Chapter 11 — Firms in a Competitive Market
desc: Price takers, P = MR = MC, profit and loss rectangles, the shutdown rule versus exit, and how entry and exit drive the long-run price to minimum ATC.
intro: A price taker chooses only its quantity. That choice, plus whether to stay open and whether to stay in the industry, decides where the market ends up: at minimum ATC with zero economic profit.
stats: 4 chunks · 2 live models · 4 checkpoints · 10-question practice exam
